messages:
mika: hey team, day 1 hiccup. accepted the org invite but i can't see any private repos and the org shows me as Active but no teams. trying to clone services/auth errors with 404/Repo not found. GH username is mikas-cli and email mika@redwood.ai

devex: welcome @mika! quick question: did you accept using the account that has the work email verified? any SSO banner on the org page?

mika: i'm on mikas-cli which has the work email verified. No SSO banner, org says ACTIVE. weirdly our onboarding doc mentions "okta group -> github team mapping" so maybe that's relevant?

ida-identity: good call. we map Okta groups to GitHub teams via SCIM/SAML group sync. If your Okta user isn't in the expected group (eng-rtc) you get org membership but no team assignments. @okta-admin can you check the group membership for mika@redwood.ai?

okta-admin: checking... I see mika is in "eng-frontend" not "eng-rtc" because the HR role defaulted them to frontend during provisioning. I can add the eng-rtc group but want to confirm which team you need.

mika: i need access to eng-rtc repos for runtime stuff (services/auth, runtime).

ida-identity: adding them to eng-rtc in Okta will push to GitHub on the next group sync. Doing that now. Note: group sync runs every 10m but we can trigger a manual sync.

okta-admin: added mika to eng-rtc and removed from "eng-frontend". triggering manual sync now.

sam-identity: manual sync kicked off. Also note GH sometimes queues team provisioning if SAML roles and SCIM collide; i'll watch the job.

jamal-devops: small gotcha: ssh vs passkeys. If you use a browser passkey for GitHub (modern web auth) that doesn't cover git+ssh. If you haven't added an SSH key or configured HTTPS creds properly you'll still see errors even after team add.

mika: i did set up a passkey for quick login but haven't added an SSH key. hold on adding one.

okta-admin: sync complete, GH shows mika as member of eng-rtc now. @ida-identity can you confirm team perms?

ida-identity: I see eng-rtc membership applied, adding repo permissions now (write access on services/auth). That should be immediate.

mika: added an SSH key and testing clone now...

mika: clone succeeded! thanks. i did notice earlier GH web UI login with passkey didn't prompt for 2FA; is that OK?

id-identity: (ida-identity) passkeys count as a form of 2FA on GitHub if configured as a second factor. However, some org policies require a hardware security key or block certain credential types; check the banner in org security settings. In your case the policy allows passkeys but git operations require SSH or proper credential helpers.

jamal-devops: fyi if anyone else uses passkeys, still add an SSH key for local git or use HTTPS with a PAT scoped to repo (but PATs need SAML authorization). We'll add a note to the onboarding doc.

devex: thanks all. Action items: okta-admin/identity confirmed group mapping issue and fixed it; devex will add a passkey/SSH note. Welcome to eng-rtc @mika!

mika: super fast fix, appreciate it! excited to jump in :rocket:
